comment: The expander reads the row states and the clock voltage straight out of the HexSeq to its left, HexSeqExp.cpp:35-48. The clock outputs count the clock as high above 1V, HexSeqExp.cpp:46, and are a sample behind it, because the voltage used is the one read on the sample before. With no HexSeq to the left nothing is written at all, so the outputs hold whatever they last carried.
